summary.text: A desolate beast corpse is the body left when a desolate beast dies, sold and used as rank six immortal materials.

claims.text: After an earthly calamity of desolate beasts, a complete desolate beast corpse is noted as a gain, with the swamp crab’s soul destroyed on Dang Hun Mountain while the body remains whole. He Feng Yang treats that sale as a complete desolate beast corpse made of the swamp crab’s listed parts; the specific corpse is covered on swamp crab corpse.
Entering Lang Ya blessed land, Tai Bai Yun Sheng points out a desolate beast corpse on the cloud soil: a huge spinefin star dragonfish lying still, whale-sized, with starry radiance in its eyes.

In treasure yellow heaven, a seller calls a pair of bat wings the most valuable part of a whole desolate beast corpse and prefers to sell the damaged corpse complete rather than strip the wings alone. Demand for desolate beast corpses is high, but shrewd Gu Immortals still refuse inflated prices; Immortal Monkey King Shi Lei calls one lot a mere damaged desolate beast corpse after bidding against Hu Immortal land spirit.

Around the eighth star hall, Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan scour for desolate beast corpses left after blood draining. One desolate beast corpse can sell for around forty immortal essence stones at best, and picking them up costs them nothing. They take nearly ten such corpses before moving on.

On that battlefield, desolate beast corpses found earlier have no souls, either because the beasts died long ago or because Shi Lei or Star Lord Wan Xiang already took them. Star Lord Wan Xiang looks over the astral wind flying heavenly boar’s huge corpse and other desolate beast corpses on the field before choosing not to loot them first.

Splitting Starry Sky grotto-heaven loot, they count seven desolate beast corpses beside one ancient desolate beast corpse and a barely living yellow jade lion. A desolate beast corpse is worth about forty immortal essence stones, while an ancient desolate beast corpse is about ten times that price.

With Shi Lei already aware of him, Fang Yuan lists desolate beast corpses openly in treasure yellow heaven and owes Hei Lou Lan forty percent of the earnings under the Snowy Mountain Alliance. Under normal circumstances such corpses are popular and rare, selling within four to six hours for immortal essence stones. Asking buyers to exchange specific goods instead (zombie recovery methods, wisdom path inheritances, and other listed needs) makes them hard to sell; twelve days in Hu Immortal blessed land yield only one sale.
He keeps selling through the following half month.

Fang Yuan lists a desolate beast corpse as an exchange condition in treasure yellow heaven for rank five bone path mortal Gu such as Battle Bone Wheel, a component of white bone chariot. Over the next half month he sells two more desolate beast corpses there for a second pair of bat desolate beast wings and dozens of immortal essence stones. He prefers not to trade corpses for stones, but refining malicious thought Gu and buying hairy men force him to; three corpses remain on sale afterward.
At auction, forty-five immortal essence stones are treated as enough to buy a desolate beast corpse.
Separately, an incomplete wisdom path inheritance reaches Fang Yuan only because the other party urgently needs an ancient desolate beast corpse.

While resting after pursuing Ying Wu Xie, Fang Yuan sells desolate beast corpses in treasure yellow heaven. Those corpses are immortal materials of high quantity, taken from desolate beast groups wiped out in Earth Trench.
In a newly formed Earth Trench, Fang Yuan finds a desolate beast corpse and treats it as free loot: a desolate beast corpse is a bunch of rank six immortal materials even when damaged.
